title: Swarm: chaos process-kill on a worker (recover to green)
description: Runs `nexus chaos swarm process-kill --target swarm-worker-2 --duration 30 --yes`. Process-kills the worker's nomad client (managers are spared to keep quorum), observes the impact, then recovers and polls docker node ls until the worker is Ready+Active.

observe.what: observed-impact probes during the kill, then cluster recovered = true

whatProves: SwarmAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync runs the embedded nexus-chaos.sh on a WORKER and recovers via a lightweight docker node ls poll (keeping inside the chaos command Duration+60s budget).
